newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to disclose Cabinet decisions at noon.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to disclose Cabinet decisions at noon.

text.p: President Clinton was set to announce Cabinet decisions on Friday at a noon (1700 GMT) news conference, the White House announced.
Administration officials said the announcement was to include his decision to nominate Transportation Secretary Federico Pena as his new Energy Department secretary.
Clinton also planned to name White House aide Alexis Herman to succeed Robert Reich as labour secretary, officials said.

In addition, Clinton planned to nominate Federal Highway Administration chief Rodney Slater to replace Pena at transportation, and an assistant secretary of Housing and Urban Development, Andrew Cuomo, to replace Henry Cisneros as HUD secretary.
